description: Tiefendaten Hamburger Hafen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. NN and KN data, as well as lattice coordinates and ordinary measurement data can be generated. The depth data are available as ASCII data. Raster data (2.52.5) are stored on NN. The data can be generated on request. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Depth data Port of Hamburg" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Hamburger Hafen, Tiefendaten, ENVI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
